name: Koinobori

categories.label: Festival post scores
categories.labelVi: Điểm từ các cột lễ hội
categories.hint: For each festival post: scoring colour (most repeated; ties skipped to next; full tie -> colour on the base flag with value 1) x number of that colour in YOUR personal post. Enter one value per post.

categories.label: Carps of colours that scored on no post
categories.labelVi: Cá chép thuộc màu không ghi điểm
categories.hint: -3 points for each carp on your personal post whose colour scored on none of the festival posts.

tiebreakers.description: The rulebook gives no tiebreaker for equal final scores.

notes: family: area-majority. Number of festival posts = players + 1; game ends when every post holds 5 koinobori cards. The scoring colour of a post uses the representation value (number of cards of that colour in the post); covered cards do not count. Your personal post holds at most 3 hidden cards. Unscoring-colour penalty counts colours not flipped on the scoring cards.
